in_sanskrit.name: हिरू
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings happiness and serves it, the one who is ever abundant with the nectar of life.

in_hindi.name: हिरू
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who brings happiness, the one who is ever abundant.

in_tamil.name: ஹிரு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is always present, the one who is in Amothathil (Heaven)

in_telugu.name: హిరు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is present always, the one who is the lord of Asha (hope)

in_marathi.name: Hiru
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiru is a Sanskrit name derived from the word hiras, meaning 'gold' or 'precious'. In Hindu mythology, Hiru is a name for the monkey god Hanuman, signifying his golden heart and selfless devotion to Lord Rama.
